why: The answer uses a rule that goes against Java: it says the indentation puts println("done") inside a braceless if. In fact only the next statement is the body, so java Order 3 prints "start" then "done". The answer also says nothing about java Order five, where Integer.parseInt throws a NumberFormatException before anything is printed.

concepts.quote: Only start, because done is inside the if and 3 is not > 5.
concepts.why: Without braces the if body is only the first statement, System.out.println("big"), so "done" always prints whatever the indentation shows.
The answer makes no claim about the class declaration.
The answer makes no claim about main, args, or the order of statements, and it misses that parseInt("five") fails before "start" is printed.
